task_signature_scope.observation_rule: primary promotion ranks every architecture on the identical FIXED_POINT_DERIVED_LLR output of the frozen T9.2.7 bit-accurate frontend; raw IQ and binary syndrome are separately closed ablations and cannot select or rescue the primary winner

task_signature_scope.causal_prefix: o_<=t,a_<t with timestamp, reset acknowledgement and past action; no future suffix
task_signature_scope.action_schema: same trusted recovery codebook, bounded residual, phase frame, leakage/reset FSM and LKG fallback rights
task_signature_scope.formal_sample_rule: identical backend config, device/scenario/trajectory cluster, six-state initial condition, exogenous innovation/RNG manifest and action opportunities for every method; post-action physical transitions are policy-specific

statistics_contract.zero_baseline_ler_rule: relative contrast and CI are null/undefined; absolute contrast only; epsilon substitution prohibited

missingness_contract.missing_external_asset: typed null with reason, never zero or worst rank
